question: 'Puanchei' is the traditional dress of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Mizoram.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mizo Puanchei** is a colourful Mizo shawl and it is famous for its attractive colour among the Mizo textiles.
 
• It is an essential occupation for every Mizo lady and It is the most used costume in** Mizo festive dances and official ceremonies**.
 
• The traditional dress worn by Mizoram women is called **'Puan'**.
 
• **Puan** is a black and white cloth worn like a skirt, which is the state dress of the state of Mizoram.
 
• It is mainly worn on the occasion of the** Puanchei** festival by Mizo women.
 
• Shawl or dupatta is a traditional Manipuri costume for women and a skirt called a "**Phanek**".
 
• **Pajama or Dhoti **is a traditional dress of Rajasthani men, and Women stick to ghagra (long skirt) and Kanchi (top).
 
• The Lungi is a traditional dress of Kerala state worn by men and women.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• GI tag is an indication, used on the product that is associated with a **"Specific Geographical Area".**
 
• Mizo Chilli is known as **"Mizoram's Birds Eye Chilli"** a Geographical Indication of Mizoram.
